sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def boxpos(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='O':
            b=n['boundary']
            return (min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b),max(p[0] for p in b),max(p[1] for p in b))
    return None
for i in range(9):
    action(['DOWN'])
    p = boxpos(current_frame)
    print(i+1, p, last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
    if p and p[0]>=50: break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
